## 1303bf6af20d

The core rotation-only semantics, exact override surface, reflection distractor, and task-local tests are strong. The concrete remaining issue is a **profile-to-lesson-role leak**.

`canonical_profile = not overrides and sample_index % 4 == 0`. Across 100 seeds, sample indices `0..4` always had this exact pattern:

```text
strict canonical profile:       true, false, false, false, true
reflection-only distractor:     false, true,  true,  true,  false
```

The default dataset exporter uses four training examples and one test example, so the query is sample index 4 and is always a strict canonical profile. The reflection-only challenge is always confined to demonstrations and never appears in the query. A role-aware learner can condition on the small canonical shape/layout and avoid demonstrating no-reflection discrimination at query time; evaluation therefore overstates how robustly the lesson teaches the distinction.

Cheapest repair: key the profile schedule by a seed-derived offset, or use a cycle length coprime to the total episode length, then add a profile-by-role census for both 3+1 and 4+1 episode configurations. Require every important semantic profile to appear in query position over a seed census.
